content: The early development of jiant took at the 2018 Frederick Jelinek Memorial Summer Workshop on Speech and Language Technologies, and was supported by Johns Hopkins University with unrestricted gifts from Amazon, Facebook, Google, Microsoft and Mitsubishi Electric Research Laboratories.
